notes: No external LED: the tutorial uses the built-in LED on pin 13, so it is not a separate part.
Potentiometer legs are read from the image as columns 10, 11, 12 in the bottom half (row e): outer legs GND (col 10) and VCC (col 12), middle leg is the wiper (SIG, col 11).

In the image the yellow wire's breadboard end is drawn at the top of the pot (around column 11, upper half). The schematic shows the wiper going to A0, so I placed it in the wiper strip, 11b.d. This assumes the pot's wiper is the middle leg.
Black wire goes to the second GND header socket in the Uno power header (GND.2). Red wire goes to 5V.
The board is shown powered over USB, but no USB cable appears in the circuit image, so none is included.
